title: ArtNet: split out ett_ values
description:
Currently ArtNet dissector uses a single `ett_artnet` value for a number of trees. This is annoying when navigating through many requests, particularly the large ArtPollReply packets as you can't effectively hide parts of the packet.

This splits it out into a few new variables to make it more convenient to naviagate.
